item.text: The five backends start pollers without retaining them. I’ll have each store keep its poller so `Close()` can cancel it and wait for its loop to exit.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('internal/storage/fs/poll.go'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('\"context\"','\"context\"\\n \"io\"'); s=s.replace('type Poller struct {','type UpdateFunc func(context.Context) (bool, error)\\n\\nvar _ io.Closer = (*Poller)(nil)\\n\\ntype Poller struct {\\n ctx context.Context\\n cancel context.CancelFunc\\n done chan struct{}\\n update UpdateFunc'); s=s.replace('func NewPoller(logger *zap.Logger, opts ...containers.Option[Poller]) *Poller {\\n\\tp := &Poller{','func NewPoller(ctx context.Context, logger *zap.Logger, update UpdateFunc, opts ...containers.Option[Poller]) *Poller {\\n ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)\\n\\tp := &Poller{\\n ctx: ctx,\\n cancel: cancel,\\n done: make(chan struct{}),\\n update: update,'); s=s.replace('func (p *Poller) Poll(ctx context.Context, update func(context.Context) (bool, error)) {\\n\\tticker := time.NewTicker(p.interval)','func (p *Poller) Poll() {\\n defer close(p.done)\\n ticker := time.NewTicker(p.interval)\\n defer ticker.Stop()'); s=s.replace('ctx.Done()', 'p.ctx.Done()').replace('update(ctx)', 'p.update(p.ctx)'); s += '\\n// Close stops polling and waits for the polling loop to exit.\\nfunc (p *Poller) Close() error {\\n p.cancel()\\n <-p.done\\n return nil\\n}\\n'; p.write_text(s)
paths=['local/store.go','git/store.go','object/s3/store.go','object/azblob/store.go','oci/store.go']
for name in paths:

 else:

 s+='\\n// Close stops background polling, if it was started.\\nfunc (s *SnapshotStore) Close() error {\\n if s.poller == nil {\\n  return nil\\n }\\n return s.poller.Close()\\n}\\n';p.write_text(s)
PY

item.text:
Polling now has an owned lifecycle. The Git, local, S3, Azure Blob, and OCI snapshot stores retain their poller and expose `Close()`; closing a store cancels polling and waits for the goroutine to exit. A store with no active poller closes safely.

Added a test that checks `Close()` waits for an in-progress update. `go test ./internal/storage/fs/...` and `git diff --check` pass.
